entries.headline: Riyadh airport casualties, Jeddah diversions and regional activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a missile attack on Riyadh airport that killed 12 people and injured 300, with all flights diverted to Jeddah as US military activity in the region increased.

entries.headline: Riyadh terminal casualties, cancellations and Jeddah backlog reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported missile impacts at a Riyadh airport terminal that killed 12 people and injured 300, with all flights cancelled and diversions creating a backlog at Jeddah. The visible post is truncated after reporting US military surveillance over Saudi Arabia.

entries.headline: Six US transports and Saudi airport disruption reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne and said missile impacts at Riyadh airport killed 12 people, injured 300 and disrupted multiple Saudi airports.

entries.headline: Riyadh airport closure, casualties and Jeddah diversions reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that missile strikes closed Riyadh airport, killing 12 people and injuring 300, with flights diverted to Jeddah and elevated US military activity over Saudi Arabia.

entries.headline: Six US cargo aircraft and Riyadh airport casualties reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne and said missile strikes at Riyadh airport killed 12 people, injured 300 and forced flights to divert to Jeddah.

entries.headline: Five transports, a spy aircraft and Riyadh terminal impacts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five military transport aircraft and a US Air Force surveillance aircraft airborne, and said missile impacts at a Riyadh airport terminal killed multiple people and forced flight diversions. The visible post is truncated thereafter.

entries.headline: Riyadh airport casualties and Jeddah diversions reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that missile impacts at Riyadh airport killed several people and forced all flights to divert to Jeddah, where aircraft were waiting to land.

entries.headline: US transports, command aircraft and Riyadh flight halt reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft over the United States alongside two nuclear command aircraft and said major airlines had halted Riyadh flights. The visible post is truncated after “reported Houthi missile…”.

entries.headline: US transports, command aircraft and Saudi flight halt reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft over the United States alongside a nuclear command aircraft and said missile impacts at Riyadh airport had halted all Saudi flights.

entries.headline: US spy and command aircraft and Saudi flight disruption reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military surveillance and command aircraft over the continental United States, missile impacts at a Riyadh airport terminal and Saudi flight diversions or cancellations. The visible post is truncated after “doctors called…”.

entries.headline: Six US transports and Riyadh flight cancellations reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including four over the United States, and said missile attacks at Riyadh airport had forced major airlines to cancel flights. The visible post is truncated thereafter.

entries.headline: US transports, Riyadh impacts and flight diversions reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military transport aircraft over the United States, missile impacts at Riyadh airport, flights diverted to Jeddah and a US Air Force surveillance aircraft. The visible post is truncated thereafter.
